ruleDefinitions.name: CodePage Modification Via MODE.COM To Russian Language
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects a CodePage modification using the "mode.com" utility to Russian language.
This behavior has been used by threat actors behind Dharma ransomware.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\mode\\\.com$") OR process_original_file_name = "MODE\.COM") AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ con\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ cp\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ select\\=.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX("\\=1251$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\=866$"))))
